title: Conformally symplectic Dynamics
summary: Dynamists have been studying Hamiltonian systems for a long time. However, many physical systems are dissipative and do not preserve a symplectic form. This is the case, for example, with systems involving friction, which multiply the symplectic form by a constant smaller than 1. We will prove that almost every point is in the unstable set of infinity for these systems and we will illustrate different situations that may arise with examples.
